{{Top|leg}}
'''Sa'tosin''' was the [[Tarasinese|indigenous name]] for the quills that grew on the backs of [[Tarasin]] forearms. The word was first recorded in the memoirs of [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]].
